messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-24018 \u2014 runtime-autoscaler backlog >= 85% for cluster/runtime (auto-escalate)
PagerDuty: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-24018
Alex Chong: acked. taking lead. will triage routing and try manual mitigations.\nSamir Patel: looking at metrics now. Queue length spike on runtime-api ingress. Any recent deploys?
Maya Li: no deploys in the last hour. Multiple customer reports of 503s and timeouts. Dash shows queue ~1800 reqs, tail latency spiking to ~4s.
Alex Chong: pulling k8s state.
Alex Chong: ```
$ kubectl -n runtime get hpa runtime-api
NAME         REFERENCE              TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
runtime-api  Deployment/runtime-api  75%/80%   8         300       8          3d
$ kubectl -n runtime get pods | grep Pending
runtime-api-66b7c Pending 0/1 ContainerCreating 0 45s
```
Samir Patel: events on the Pending pods: "Failed to create instance: UnauthorizedOperation: ec2:RunInstances". Autoscaler logs showing 403 from AWS.
DevOps Bot: autoscaler log snippet 1719123520:
DevOps Bot: ```
2026-06-02T12:12:00Z autoscaler ERROR CreateInstances failed: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform: ec2:RunInstances on resource: arn:aws:ec2:... status=403
2026-06-02T12:12:01Z autoscaler WARN will retry in 20s
```
Maya Li: impact assessment: hosted customers on shared pools degraded, dedicated reserved pools unaffected. Estimated affected accounts: 6 orgs, ~9 services. Opening incident ticket for infra assistance.
Alex Chong: trying a manual cold-pool fallback. spinning pre-warmed GPU instances in the fallback-host pool with an explicit instance profile. If AWS denies, infra console assist needed.
Alex Chong: ```
# manual fallback provisioning
aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-gpu-stable-202606 --instance-type g4dn.xlarge --count 3 --iam-instance-profile Name=redwood-fallback-profile
```
Alex Chong: result: 1/3 instances launched successfully, 2 failed with UnauthorizedOperation.
Samir Patel: once nodes exist kubelet joins and pods schedule. I've restarted runtime-api deployment to rebalance.
Samir Patel: ```
$ kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/runtime-api
deployment.apps/runtime-api restarted
```
Maya Li: queue length dropping: 1800 -> 520 over 4min after the first fallback node joined. Customer reports show partial recovery. Posting brief status update to status.redwood: "We are investigating degraded inference throughput; engineers have applied a partial mitigation."
Alex Chong: root cause hypothesis: autoscaler IAM role lost ec2:RunInstances permission due to role change or token rotation earlier today around 2026-06-02T11:50Z. Need infra to restore permissions and audit change.
Samir Patel: action items: 1) infra to restore RunInstances permission for autoscaler role (ticket INFRA-8921), 2) add structured alert when autoscaler returns 403 so infra gets paged immediately (ENG-OPS-501), 3) validate fallback pool non-privileged provisioning path.
Maya Li: opened INFRA-8921 and ENG-OPS-501, pinged infra on-call and Security Slack. Drafted customer notification for affected accounts.
PagerDuty: PD-24018 acknowledged by Alex Chong at 1719123465
Alex Chong: documented workaround steps and left an action list in the incident doc: https://docs.redwood/cases/PD-24018
Oncall Rotation: ack — taking over monitoring for the next 45min. Summary: autoscaler cannot create nodes due to UnauthorizedOperation (ec2:RunInstances). Partial mitigation: provisioned fallback GPU node(s) manually, queue draining but monitor for regression.
DevOps Bot: note — recommend adding explicit 403 classification to autoscaler alert rules.
Maya Li: suggest status remain "Partial Degraded" until INFRA-8921 confirms IAM fix. Communicated to affected customers and support reps.
Samir Patel: long-term followups: improve autoscaler telemetry, add safe-mode manual provisioning runbook, and ensure fallback instance profile is tested monthly (ENG-OPS-501).
Alex Chong: handing off to next on-call in 40min. If autoscaler recovers and reclaims capacity, change status accordingly.
Incident Bot: PD-24018 status changed to "resolved (mitigated)" at 1719124056
